translations.idiomatic: Liang sima is lü xu, wu sima is bi chief—only the names differ with the affair.

sentences.zh: 此乃三代六鄉六軍之遺法。

translations.literal: This is the remnant law of the Three Dynasties' six xiang and six armies.
translations.idiomatic: This is the remnant law of the Three Dynasties' six xiang and six armies.

sentences.zh: 其法見於書，自夏以來，至周不改。

translations.literal: The law appears in the books; from Xia onward to Zhou it was not changed.
translations.idiomatic: The law appears in the books; from Xia onward to Zhou it was not changed.

sentences.zh: 秦雖決裂阡陌，然什伍之尚如古製，此所以兵眾而強也。

translations.literal: Though Qin sundered the field paths, yet the grouping of ten and five remained as in antiquity—hence troops were numerous and strong.
translations.idiomatic: Though Qin sundered the field paths, yet the grouping of ten and five remained as in antiquity—hence troops were numerous and strong.

sentences.zh: 征伐唯府兵為近之。

translations.literal: In campaigns only fubing came nearest.
translations.idiomatic: In campaigns only fubing came nearest.

sentences.zh: 今舍已然之成憲，而乃守五代亂亡之餘法，其不足以致安強無疑。

translations.literal: Today abandoning established enduring institutions and keeping only the remnant law after the Five Dynasties' disorder and fall—there is no doubt it is insufficient to bring peace and strength.
translations.idiomatic: Today abandoning established enduring institutions and keeping only the remnant law after the Five Dynasties' disorder and fall—there is no doubt it is insufficient to bring peace and strength.

sentences.zh: 然人皆恬然不以因循為可憂者，所見淺近也。

translations.literal: Yet everyone is placid and does not regard clinging to the old as a worry—their vision is shallow and near."
translations.idiomatic: Yet everyone is placid and does not regard clinging to the old as a worry—their vision is shallow and near."

sentences.zh: 安石又奏：“義勇須三丁以上，請如府界，兩丁以上盡籍之。

translations.literal: Anshi also memorialized: "Yiyong require three ding and above; please, as in the capital district, register all with two ding and above.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi also memorialized, "Yiyong require three ding and above; please, as in the capital district, register all with two ding and above.

sentences.zh: 三丁即出戍，誘以厚利；

translations.literal: Those with three ding go on garrison, enticed by generous reward;
translations.idiomatic: Those with three ding go on garrison, enticed by generous reward;

sentences.zh: 而兩丁即止令於巡檢上番，如府界法。

translations.literal: those with two ding are only ordered to rotate on patrol duty as in the capital district.
translations.idiomatic: those with two ding are only ordered to rotate on patrol duty as in the capital district.

sentences.zh: 大略不過如此。

translations.literal: Broadly it will not exceed this.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly it will not exceed this.

sentences.zh: 當遣人與經略、轉運司及諸州長吏議之，及訪本路民情所苦所欲，因以寓法。

translations.literal: Men should be sent to discuss with frontier commissioners, transport commissioners, and prefectural chief officials, and to inquire into what the people of this circuit find bitter and desire, and thereby embody the law."
translations.idiomatic: Men should be sent to discuss with frontier commissioners, transport commissioners, and prefectural chief officials, and to inquire into what the people of this circuit find bitter and desire, and thereby embody the law."

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“河東修義勇強壯法，又令團集保甲，如何？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In Hedong they refine the strong-yiyong law and also order grouping baojia—how is that?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "In Hedong they refine the strong-yiyong law and also order grouping baojia—how is that?"

sentences.zh: ”安石對曰：“義勇須隱括丁數，若因團集保甲，即一動而兩業就。

translations.literal: Anshi answered: "Yiyong require hidden registration of ding numbers; if through grouping baojia, then one move accomplishes two tasks.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi answered, "Yiyong require hidden registration of ding numbers; if through grouping baojia, then one move accomplishes two tasks.

sentences.zh: 今既遣官隱括義勇，又別遣官團結保甲，即分為兩事，恐民不能無擾。

translations.literal: Now if officials are sent to register yiyong in secret and separately officials are sent to group baojia, it is divided into two affairs and the people surely cannot be without disturbance."
translations.idiomatic: Now if officials are sent to register yiyong in secret and separately officials are sent to group baojia, it is divided into two affairs and the people surely cannot be without disturbance."

sentences.zh: ”或曰：“保甲不可代正軍上番否？

translations.literal: Someone said: "Can baojia not replace regular troops on rotating duty?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "Can baojia not replace regular troops on rotating duty?"

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“俟其習熟，然後上番。

translations.literal: Anshi said: "Wait until they are practiced and familiar, then rotate on duty.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "Wait until they are practiced and familiar, then rotate on duty.

sentences.zh: 然東兵技藝亦弗能優於義勇、保甲，臣觀廣勇、虎翼兵固然。

translations.literal: Yet eastern troops' skills also cannot surpass yiyong and baojia—your servant has observed Guangyong and Huyi troops to be so.
translations.idiomatic: Yet eastern troops' skills also cannot surpass yiyong and baojia—I have observed Guangyong and Huyi troops to be so.

sentences.zh: 今為募兵者，大抵皆偷惰頑猾不能自振之人。

translations.literal: Today those who become hired troops are mostly lazy, stubborn, and worthless men unable to rouse themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Today those who become hired troops are mostly lazy, stubborn, and worthless men unable to rouse themselves.

sentences.zh: 為農者，皆樸力一心聽令之人，則緩急莫如民兵可用。

translations.literal: Those who farm are all plain, strong, single-minded men who heed orders—then in emergency none are so usable as militia."
translations.idiomatic: Those who farm are all plain, strong, single-minded men who heed orders—then in emergency none are so usable as militia."

sentences.zh: ”馮京曰：“ 太祖征伐天下，豈用農兵？

translations.literal: " Feng Jing said: "When Taizu campaigned to pacify the realm, did he use farming soldiers?"
translations.idiomatic: " Feng Jing said, "When Taizu campaigned to pacify the realm, did he use farming soldiers?"

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“太祖時接五代，百姓困極，豪傑多以從軍為利。

translations.literal: " Anshi said: "In Taizu's time, connecting with the Five Dynasties, the common people were extremely distressed and heroes mostly took following the army as profit.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Anshi said, "In Taizu's time, connecting with the Five Dynasties, the common people were extremely distressed and heroes mostly took following the army as profit.

sentences.zh: 今百姓安業樂生，而軍中不復有如向時拔起為公侯者，即豪傑不復在軍，而應募者大抵皆偷惰不能自振之人爾。

translations.literal: Today the common people are secure in their occupations and glad to live, and in the army there are no longer men like those times who rose to be dukes and marquises; heroes are no longer in the army, and those who answer recruitment are mostly lazy men unable to rouse themselves."
translations.idiomatic: Today the common people are secure in their occupations and glad to live, and in the army there are no longer men like those times who rose to be dukes and marquises; heroes are no longer in the army, and those who answer recruitment are mostly lazy men unable to rouse themselves."

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“兵之強弱在人。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Whether troops are strong or weak lies in men."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Whether troops are strong or weak lies in men."

sentences.zh: 五代兵弱，至世宗而強。

translations.literal: In the Five Dynasties troops were weak; by Shizong they were strong."
translations.idiomatic: In the Five Dynasties troops were weak; by Shizong they were strong."

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“世宗所收，亦皆天下亡命強梁之人。

translations.literal: Anshi said: "What Shizong gathered were also all the realm's fugitives and powerful ruffians."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "What Shizong gathered were also all the realm's fugitives and powerful ruffians."

sentences.zh: ”文彥博曰：“以道佐人主者不以兵強天下。

translations.literal: Wen Yanbo said: "One who assists a ruler with the Way does not strengthen the realm with troops."
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo said, "One who assists a ruler with the Way does not strengthen the realm with troops."

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“以兵強天下者非道也，然有道者固能柔能剛，能弱能強。

translations.literal: Anshi said: "To strengthen the realm with troops is not the Way, yet one who has the Way can indeed be soft and firm, weak and strong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "To strengthen the realm with troops is not the Way, yet one who has the Way can indeed be soft and firm, weak and strong.

sentences.zh: 方其能剛強，必不至柔弱。

translations.literal: When he can be firm and strong, he surely will not reach weakness.
translations.idiomatic: When he can be firm and strong, he surely will not reach weakness.

sentences.zh: 張皇六師，固先王之所尚也，但不當專務兵強爾。

translations.literal: Displaying the six armies is what the former kings honored, but one should not specialize solely in strengthening troops."
translations.idiomatic: Displaying the six armies is what the former kings honored, but one should not specialize solely in strengthening troops."

sentences.zh: ”帝卒從安石議。

translations.literal: The emperor finally followed Anshi's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor finally followed Wang Anshi's proposal.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：“保甲、義勇芻糧之費，當預為之計。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The expense of fodder and grain for baojia and yiyong should be planned in advance."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The expense of fodder and grain for baojia and yiyong should be planned in advance."

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“當減募兵之費以供之。

translations.literal: Anshi said: "Hired-troop expenses should be reduced to supply it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "Hired-troop expenses should be reduced to supply it.

sentences.zh: 所供保甲之費，才養兵十之一二。

translations.literal: The expense supplied to baojia is only one or two tenths of maintaining troops.
translations.idiomatic: The expense supplied to baojia is only one or two tenths of maintaining troops.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“ 畿內募兵之數已減於舊。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The number of hired troops within the capital district has already been reduced from old.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The number of hired troops within the capital district has already been reduced from old.

sentences.zh: 強本之勢，未可悉減。

translations.literal: The momentum of strengthening the root cannot be entirely reduced."
translations.idiomatic: The momentum of strengthening the root cannot be entirely reduced."

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“既有保甲代其役，即不須募兵。

translations.literal: Anshi said: "Since baojia replace their corvée, hired troops are not needed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "Since baojia replace their corvée, hired troops are not needed.

sentences.zh: 今京師募兵，逃死停放，一季乃數千，但勿招填，即為可減。

translations.literal: Today capital hired troops who flee, die, or are suspended for a season number in the thousands; only do not recruit to fill vacancies and reduction is possible.
translations.idiomatic: Today capital hired troops who flee, die, or are suspended for a season number in the thousands; only do not recruit to fill vacancies and reduction is possible.

sentences.zh: 然今廂軍既少，禁兵亦不多，臣願早訓練民兵。

translations.literal: Yet today ward troops are already few and palace guards not many; your servant wishes early training of militia.
translations.idiomatic: Yet today ward troops are already few and palace guards not many; I wish early training of militia.

sentences.zh: 民兵成，則募兵當減矣。

translations.literal: When militia are formed, hired troops should be reduced."
translations.idiomatic: When militia are formed, hired troops should be reduced."

sentences.zh: ”又為上言：“今河北義勇雖十八萬，然所可獎慰者不過酋豪百數十人而已。

translations.literal: He also said to the emperor: "Today Hebei yiyong number 180,000, yet those who can be rewarded and comforted do not exceed a few hundred chieftains and heroes.
translations.idiomatic: He also said to the emperor, "Today Hebei yiyong number 180,000, yet those who can be rewarded and comforted do not exceed a few hundred chieftains and heroes.

sentences.zh: 此府兵之遺意也。

translations.literal: This is the remnant intent of fubing."
translations.idiomatic: This is the remnant intent of fubing."

sentences.zh: ”帝以為然，令議其法。

translations.literal: The emperor thought it correct and ordered discussion of the law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thought it correct and ordered discussion of the law.

sentences.zh: 樞密院傳上旨，以府界保甲十日一番，慮大促無以精武事，其以一月為一番。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs transmitted the imperial intent: because capital-district baojia rotated every ten days, fearing the interval was too short to refine martial affairs, it should be one month per rotation.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs transmitted the imperial intent: because capital-district baojia rotated every ten days, fearing the interval was too short to refine martial affairs, it should be one month per rotation.

sentences.zh: 安石奏曰：“今保甲十日一番，計一年餘八月當番，若須一月，即番愈疏。

translations.literal: Anshi memorialized: "Today baojia rotate every ten days; reckoned over a year, a little more than eight months on duty; if one month is required, rotation becomes still sparser.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi memorialized, "Today baojia rotate every ten days; reckoned over a year, a little more than eight months on duty; if one month is required, rotation becomes still sparser.

sentences.zh: 又昨與百姓約十日一番，今遽改命，恐愈為人扇惑。

translations.literal: Moreover yesterday an agreement was made with the common people for ten-day rotation; to change the order abruptly will surely give people more to incite.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover yesterday an agreement was made with the common people for ten-day rotation; to change the order abruptly will surely give people more to incite.

sentences.zh: 宜俟其習熟，徐議其更番。

translations.literal: One should wait until they are practiced and familiar and slowly discuss changing rotation.
translations.idiomatic: One should wait until they are practiced and familiar and slowly discuss changing rotation.

sentences.zh: 且今保甲閱藝八等，勸獎至優，人競私習，不必上番然後就學。

translations.literal: Moreover today baojia review skills in eight grades with rewards to the utmost; people compete in private practice and need not wait for rotating duty to learn.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover today baojia review skills in eight grades with rewards to the utmost; people compete in private practice and need not wait for rotating duty to learn.

sentences.zh: 臣愚，願以數年，其藝非特勝義勇，當必勝正兵。

translations.literal: Your servant is foolish and wishes that in several years their skill will not only surpass yiyong but surely surpass regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: I am foolish and wish that in several years their skill will not only surpass yiyong but surely surpass regular troops.

sentences.zh: 正兵技藝取應官法而已，非若保甲人人有勸心也。

translations.literal: Regular troops' skills merely meet the official law; they are not like baojia, where every man has encouragement in his heart."
translations.idiomatic: Regular troops' skills merely meet the official law; they are not like baojia, where every man has encouragement in his heart."

sentences.zh: 元豐八年，哲宗嗣位，知陳州司馬光上疏乞罷保甲，曰：

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yuanfeng, when Zhezong succeeded, Sima Guang, knowing Chen prefecture, memorialized begging to abolish baojia, saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yuanfeng, when Zhezong succeeded, Sima Guang, prefect of Chen, memorialized begging to abolish baojia, saying:

sentences.zh: 兵出民間，雖雲古法，然古者八百家才出甲士三人、步卒七十二人，閑民甚多，三時務農，一時講武，不妨稼穡。

translations.literal: Troops drawn from among the people—though called an ancient method, in antiquity eight hundred households produced only three armored men and seventy-two foot soldiers; idle people were very numerous, and in three seasons they worked at farming and in one season practiced arms, not harming the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Troops drawn from among the people—though called an ancient method, in antiquity eight hundred households produced only three armored men and seventy-two foot soldiers; idle people were very numerous, and in three seasons they worked at farming and in one season practiced arms, not harming the crops.

sentences.zh: 自兩司馬以上，皆選賢士大夫為之，無侵漁之患，故卒乘輯睦，動則有功。

translations.literal: From liang sima upward, all selected worthy scholar-officials to serve; there was no worry of encroachment and plunder, and thus chariots and foot soldiers were harmonious and effective when they moved.
translations.idiomatic: From liang sima upward, all selected worthy scholar-officials to serve; there was no worry of encroachment and plunder, and thus chariots and foot soldiers were harmonious and effective when they moved.

sentences.zh: 今籍鄉村之民，二丁取一以為保甲，授以弓弩，教之戰陣，是農民半為兵也。

translations.literal: Today village people are registered; one man is taken from every two ding to make baojia, given bows and crossbows, and taught battle arrays—half the farmers have become soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Today village people are registered; one man is taken from every two ding to make baojia, given bows and crossbows, and taught battle arrays—half the farmers have become soldiers.

sentences.zh: 三四年來，又令河北、河東、陝西置都教場，無問四時，每五日一教。

translations.literal: In the last three or four years, Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi have also established capital training grounds; regardless of the four seasons, every five days there is one drill.
translations.idiomatic: In the last three or four years, Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi have also established capital training grounds; regardless of the four seasons, every five days there is one drill.

sentences.zh: 特置使者比監司，專切提舉，州縣不得關預。

translations.literal: Envoys specially appointed comparable to circuit commissioners were set up to supervise exclusively; prefectures and counties might not interfere.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys specially appointed comparable to circuit commissioners were set up to supervise exclusively; prefectures and counties might not interfere.

sentences.zh: 每一丁教閱，一丁供送，雖雲五日，而保正，長以泥堋除草為名，聚之教場，得賂則縱，否則留之，是三路耕耘收獲稼穡之業幾盡廢也。

translations.literal: For every one ding drilled, one ding supplied escort; though it is said to be five days, bao chiefs and heads in the name of tamping targets and clearing weeds gather them at the training ground—if bribed they are released, otherwise detained—so that farming and harvest in the three circuits are nearly all abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: For every one ding drilled, one ding supplied escort; though it is said to be five days, bao chiefs and heads in the name of tamping targets and clearing weeds gather them at the training ground—if bribed they are released, otherwise detained—so that farming and harvest in the three circuits are nearly all abandoned.

sentences.zh: 自唐開元以來，民兵法壞，戍守戰攻，盡募長征兵士，民間何嚐習兵？

translations.literal: Since the Kaiyuan era of Tang, the militia law decayed; garrison defense and campaigning relied entirely on recruiting long-service troops—when did the people ever practice arms?
translations.idiomatic: Since the Kaiyuan era of Tang, the militia law decayed; garrison defense and campaigning relied entirely on recruiting long-service troops—when did the people ever practice arms?

sentences.zh: 國家承平百有餘年，戴白之老不識兵革，一旦畎畝之人皆戎服執兵，奔驅滿野，耆舊歎息，以為不祥。

translations.literal: The state has enjoyed peace for more than a hundred years; white-haired elders have not known weapons. Suddenly men of the fields all wear armor, hold weapons, and run filling the wilds—the elders sigh and regard it as ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: The state has enjoyed peace for more than a hundred years; white-haired elders have not known weapons. Suddenly men of the fields all wear armor, hold weapons, and run filling the wilds—the elders sigh and regard it as ill-omened.

sentences.zh: 事既草創，調發無法，比戶騷擾，不遺一家。

translations.literal: The affair being newly devised, there is no law for mobilization; every household is disturbed, not one spared.
translations.idiomatic: The affair being newly devised, there is no law for mobilization; every household is disturbed, not one spared.

sentences.zh: 又巡檢、指使按行鄉村，往來如織；

translations.literal: Patrol inspectors and envoys travel the villages back and forth like weaving;
translations.idiomatic: Patrol inspectors and envoys travel the villages back and forth like weaving;

sentences.zh: 保正、保長，依倚弄權，坐索供給，多責賂遺，小不副意，妄加鞭撻，蠶食行伍，不知紀極。

translations.literal: bao zheng and bao chiefs rely on and wield power, sit and demand supplies, impose many bribes and gifts, and for slight dissatisfaction falsely add flogging, gnawing the ranks beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: bao zheng and bao chiefs rely on and wield power, sit and demand supplies, impose many bribes and gifts, and for slight dissatisfaction falsely add flogging, gnawing the ranks beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 中下之民，罄家所有，侵肌削骨，無以供億，愁苦困弊，靡所投訴，流移四方，繈屬盈路。

translations.literal: Middle and lower people exhaust all the family has, invading flesh and paring bone, unable to supply demands, distressed and impoverished with nowhere to appeal, drifting to the four quarters, infants and swaddled children filling the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Middle and lower people exhaust all the family has, invading flesh and paring bone, unable to supply demands, distressed and impoverished with nowhere to appeal, drifting to the four quarters, infants and swaddled children filling the roads.

sentences.zh: 又朝廷時遣使者，遍行按閱，所至犒設賞賚，糜費金帛，以巨萬計。

translations.literal: Moreover the court from time to time sends envoys to tour and review everywhere; wherever they arrive they bestow rewards and gifts, wasting gold and silk by the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the court from time to time sends envoys to tour and review everywhere; wherever they arrive they bestow rewards and gifts, wasting gold and silk by the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 此皆鞭撻平民銖兩丈尺而斂之，一旦用之如糞土。

translations.literal: All this is flogged and levied from the common people by the ounce and foot, yet once used it is like dung and soil.
translations.idiomatic: All this is flogged and levied from the common people by the ounce and foot, yet once used it is like dung and soil.

sentences.zh: 而鄉村之民，但苦勞役，不感恩澤。

translations.literal: Yet village people only suffer forced labor and do not feel imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: Yet village people only suffer forced labor and do not feel imperial grace.

sentences.zh: 農民之勞既如披，國家之費又如此，終何所用哉？

translations.literal: If farmers' labor is already like being flayed and the state's expense is also like this, what use is there in the end?
translations.idiomatic: If farmers' labor is already like being flayed and the state's expense is also like this, what use is there in the end?

sentences.zh: 若使之捕盜賊，衛鄉里，則何必如此之多？

translations.literal: If they are made to capture bandits and guard the village, why need there be so many?
translations.idiomatic: If they are made to capture bandits and guard the village, why need there be so many?

sentences.zh: 使之戍邊境，事征伐，則彼遠方之民，以騎射為業，以攻戰為俗，自幼及長，更無他務。

translations.literal: If they are made to garrison the border and undertake campaigns, then the people of those distant regions take horsemanship as their occupation and attack and battle as their custom—from youth to age they have no other business.
translations.idiomatic: If they are made to garrison the border and undertake campaigns, then the people of those distant regions take horsemanship as their occupation and attack and battle as their custom—from youth to age they have no other business.

sentences.zh: 中國之民，大半服田力穡，雖復授以兵械，教之擊刺，在教場之中坐作進退，有似嚴整，必若使之與敵人相遇，填然鼓之，鳴鏑始交，其奔北潰敗可以前料，決無疑也，豈不誤國事乎？

translations.literal: The people of China, for the most part, wear the fields and strain at sowing; even if they are again given arms and taught thrust and stab, in the drill ground their sitting, rising, advancing, and withdrawing seem quite strict; but if they must meet the enemy, when the drums roll and whistling arrows first cross, their flight and rout can be foreseen in advance—there is absolutely no doubt—would this not mistake state affairs?
translations.idiomatic: Most of the people of China live by tilling the fields and toiling at the harvest. Even if you arm them and teach them thrust and parry, their drill-ground maneuvers—sitting, rising, advancing, withdrawing—may look admirably precise; yet put them face to face with the enemy, let the war drums thunder and the whistling arrows fly, and you can predict their rout in advance beyond any doubt. Would that not be a disaster for the state?

sentences.zh: 又悉罷三路巡檢下兵士及諸縣弓手，皆易以保甲。

translations.literal: Moreover all soldiers under patrol inspectors in the three circuits and bowmen in the various counties were abolished and replaced with baojia.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, all soldiers under the patrol inspectors in the three circuits and the bowmen in the counties were abolished and replaced with baojia.

sentences.zh: 主簿兼縣尉，但主草市以裏；

translations.literal: The registrar also served as county captain, but only governed market towns within a li;
translations.idiomatic: The registrar also served as county captain, but only governed market towns within a li;

sentences.zh: 其鄉村盜賊，悉委巡檢，而巡檢兼掌巡按保甲教閱，朝夕奔走，猶恐不辦，何暇逐捕盜賊哉？

translations.literal: village bandits were all entrusted to patrol inspectors, yet patrol inspectors also took charge of touring and reviewing baojia drill—running to and fro morning and evening, still fearing they could not manage it; when would they have leisure to pursue and capture bandits?
translations.idiomatic: Rural bandits were all left to the patrol inspectors, yet those inspectors also had to tour and supervise baojia drill—rushing about from dawn to dusk, barely able to keep up. How could they find time to hunt down thieves?

sentences.zh: 又保甲中往往有自為盜者，亦有乘保馬行劫者。

translations.literal: Moreover within baojia there were often those who themselves became bandits, and some who rode protected horses to rob on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, within the baojia ranks there were often men who became bandits themselves, and some who used the protected horses to commit highway robbery.

sentences.zh: 然則設保甲、保馬本以除盜，乃更資盜也。

translations.literal: Thus establishing baojia and protected horses was originally to eliminate bandits, yet it only supplied bandits instead.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the baojia and protected-horse systems were meant to eliminate bandits, yet they only armed and enabled them.

sentences.zh: 自教閱保甲以來，河東、陝西、京西盜賊已多，至敢白晝公行，入縣鎮，殺官吏。

translations.literal: Since drilling baojia began, bandits in Hedong, Shaanxi, and Jingxi have already grown numerous, even daring to walk openly by day, enter county towns, and kill officials.
translations.idiomatic: Since baojia drill began, banditry in Hedong, Shaanxi, and Jingxi has grown so rampant that thieves dare walk openly in daylight, enter county towns, and kill officials.

sentences.zh: 官軍追討，經曆歲月，終不能製。

translations.literal: Government troops pursued and punished them, but after months and years they still could not be controlled.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops pursued them for months and years without ever bringing them under control.

sentences.zh: 況三路未至大饑，而盜賊猖熾已如此，萬一遇數千里之蝗旱，而失業饑寒、武藝成就之人，所在蜂起以應之，其為國家之患，可勝言哉！

translations.literal: Moreover the three circuits have not yet reached great famine, yet bandits are already so rampant; should there by chance be locusts and drought across thousands of li, and men who have lost their livelihoods, suffer hunger and cold, and have completed martial skills rise everywhere in swarms to respond, the harm to the state—can it be fully told?
translations.idiomatic: And this while the three circuits have not yet suffered great famine. Should a locust plague and drought stretch across thousands of li, how many jobless, hungry, cold, and militarily trained men would rise in swarms everywhere? The peril to the state is beyond words.

sentences.zh: 此非小事，不可以忽。

translations.literal: This is no small matter and must not be neglected.
translations.idiomatic: This is no small matter and must not be neglected.

sentences.zh: 夫奪其衣食，使無以為生，是驅民為盜也；

translations.literal: To seize their food and clothing so they have no means to live—this is driving the people to become bandits;
translations.idiomatic: To strip them of food and clothing so they cannot live—this drives the people into banditry;

sentences.zh: 使比屋習戰，勸以官賞，是教民為盜也；

translations.literal: to make every household practice war and encourage them with official rewards—this is teaching the people to become bandits;
translations.idiomatic: to drill every household for war and lure them with official rewards—this teaches the people banditry;

sentences.zh: 又撤去捕盜之人，是縱民為盜也。

translations.literal: and again to remove those who capture bandits—this is releasing the people to become bandits.
translations.idiomatic: and to remove those who hunt bandits—this unleashes the people as bandits.

sentences.zh: 謀國如此，果為利乎？

translations.literal: To plan for the state in this way—is it truly for benefit?
translations.idiomatic: To plan for the state in this way—is it truly for the state's benefit?

sentences.zh: 害乎？

translations.literal: Or for harm?
translations.idiomatic: Or for harm?

sentences.zh: 且向者干進之士，說先帝以征伐開拓之策，故立保甲、戶馬、保馬等法。

translations.literal: Moreover formerly men seeking advancement persuaded the late emperor with policies of campaigning and expansion, and therefore established the laws of baojia, household horses, protected horses, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, men seeking advancement once persuaded the late emperor with plans for conquest and territorial expansion, and on that basis established baojia, household horses, protected horses, and the like.

sentences.zh: 近者登極赦書有云：“應緣邊州軍，仰逐處長吏並巡檢、使臣、鈐轄、兵士及邊上人戶不得侵擾外界，務要靜守疆埸，勿令騷擾。

translations.literal: Recently the accession amnesty edict stated: "For all border prefectures and armies, local chief officials together with patrol inspectors, commissioners, controllers, soldiers, and frontier households must not harass the outer realm; they must earnestly keep the borders quiet and not allow disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the accession amnesty edict stated: "For all border prefectures and armies, local chief officials together with patrol inspectors, commissioners, controllers, soldiers, and frontier households must not harass foreign territory; they must earnestly keep the borders quiet and allow no disturbance.

sentences.zh: ”此蓋聖意欲惠綏殊才，休息生民，中外之人孰不歸戴？

translations.literal: " This surely reflects the sage intent to show kindness and pacify distant peoples, to give the living people rest—who within and without would not turn in homage?
translations.idiomatic: " This surely reflects the sage intent to show kindness and pacify distant peoples, to give the living people rest—who within and without would not turn in homage?

sentences.zh: 然則保甲、戶馬復何所用？

translations.literal: Then of what further use are baojia and household horses?
translations.idiomatic: Then of what further use are baojia and household horses?

sentences.zh: 或今雖罷戶馬，寬保馬，而保甲猶存者，蓋未有以其利害之詳奏聞者也。

translations.literal: Perhaps though household horses are now abolished and protected horses relaxed, yet baojia still remain because no one has memorialized the throne with full details of their benefits and harms.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps though household horses are now abolished and protected horses relaxed, baojia still remain because no one has yet memorialized the throne with a full account of their benefits and harms.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為悉罷保甲使歸農，召提舉官還朝，量逐縣戶口，每五十戶置弓手一人，略依緣邊弓箭手法，許蔭本戶田二頃，悉免其稅役。

translations.literal: Your servant foolishly holds that baojia should all be abolished and the people returned to farming; promotion officials should be recalled to court; according to each county's registered households, one bowman should be placed for every fifty households, roughly following the border archer method, permitted to shield two qing of their household's fields, and entirely exempted from taxes and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant humbly proposes abolishing baojia entirely and returning the people to farming; recalling the promotion officials to court; and, according to each county's registered households, appointing one bowman per fifty households on the model of the frontier archer system, with exemption for two qing of household land and full relief from taxes and corvée.

sentences.zh: 除出賊地分，更不立三限科校，但令捕賊給賞。

translations.literal: Except in bandit districts, no three-tier quotas or assessments should be set; only let capturing bandits receive rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Except in bandit districts, abolish the three-tier quotas and assessments; reward only the capture of bandits.

sentences.zh: 若獲賊數多及能獲強惡賊人者，各隨功大小遷補職級，或補班行，務在優假弓手，使人勸募。

translations.literal: If many bandits are captured or fierce and wicked bandits are taken, each should be promoted in rank according to merit, or appointed to clerical ranks; the aim must be to favor bowmen so that men are encouraged to enlist.
translations.idiomatic: Those who capture many bandits, or especially fierce ones, should be promoted according to merit or given clerical appointments; bowmen must be favored so that men are encouraged to enlist.

sentences.zh: 然後募本縣鄉村戶有勇力武藝者投充，計即今保甲中有勇力武藝者必多願應募。

translations.literal: Then recruit from the county's village households those with strength and martial skill to fill posts; it is reckoned that among present baojia many with strength and skill would gladly volunteer.
translations.idiomatic: Then recruit from village households in the county those with strength and martial skill; many men now in baojia who possess such skills would gladly volunteer.

sentences.zh: 若一人缺額，有二人以上爭投者，即委本縣令、尉選武藝高強者充。

translations.literal: If one post is vacant and two or more compete to enlist, the county magistrate and captain should be entrusted to select the stronger in martial skill.
translations.idiomatic: If one post is vacant and two or more men compete, let the magistrate and county captain choose the stronger in martial skill.

sentences.zh: 或武藝衰退者，許他人指名與之比較，若武藝勝於舊者，即令衝替，其被替者，更不得蔭田。

translations.literal: Or if martial skill has declined, others may be allowed to name and compare; if skill surpasses the incumbent, he should be displaced; the displaced man may no longer shield fields.
translations.idiomatic: If a man's skill has declined, allow others to challenge him in named comparison; whoever proves superior should replace him, and the displaced man should lose his land exemption.

sentences.zh: 如此，則不必教閱，武藝自然精熟。

translations.literal: Thus there would be no need for drill review; martial skill would naturally become refined.
translations.idiomatic: Thus there would be no need for formal drill; martial skill would naturally become expert.

sentences.zh: 一縣之中，其壯勇者既為弓手，其羸弱者雖使為盜，亦不能為患。

translations.literal: Within a county, the strong and brave having become bowmen, even if the weak and feeble were made bandits they could not become a scourge.
translations.idiomatic: Within a county, once the strong and brave serve as bowmen, even if the weak turned to banditry they could not become a serious threat.

sentences.zh: 仍委本州及提點刑獄常按察，令佐有取舍不公者，嚴行典憲。

translations.literal: Still entrust the prefecture and the judicial intendant to inspect regularly; where magistrates and assistants are partial or unjust, strictly apply the statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Entrust the prefecture and judicial intendant with regular inspection; where magistrates and assistants are partial or unjust, punish them strictly under the statutes.

sentences.zh: 若召募不足，且即於鄉村戶上依舊條權差，候有投名者即令充替。

translations.literal: If recruitment is insufficient, temporarily assign by rotation from village households according to old rules, and when volunteers appear let them replace the assignees.
translations.idiomatic: If recruitment falls short, temporarily assign village households by rotation under the old rules until volunteers appear to take their places.

sentences.zh: 其餘巡檢兵士、縣尉弓手、耆老、壯丁逐捕盜賊，並乞依祖宗舊法。

translations.literal: As for the rest—patrol soldiers, county-captain bowmen, elders, and stalwart youths pursuing bandits—all beg to follow the ancestral laws.
translations.idiomatic: As for patrol soldiers, county-captain bowmen, elders, and stalwart youths in pursuit of bandits, let all of them follow the ancestral laws again.

sentences.zh: 五月，以光為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Guang was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Guang was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 光欲復申前說，以為教閱保甲公私勞費而無所用。

translations.literal: Guang wished again to set forth his earlier argument, holding that drilling baojia cost public and private labor and expense without use.
translations.idiomatic: Guang wished to press his earlier argument again, holding that drilling baojia imposed heavy public and private costs to no purpose.

sentences.zh: 是時，資政殿學士韓維、侍讀呂公著欲復上前奏，先是進呈，乞罷團教。

translations.literal: At this time Han Wei, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, and Lecturer Lü Gongzhu wished to present their former memorials to the throne; they had first submitted them, begging to abolish mass drill.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Han Wei, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, and Lecturer Lü Gongzhu wished to present their earlier memorials; they had already submitted a request to abolish mass drill.

sentences.zh: 詔府界、三路保甲自來年正月以後並罷團教，仍依舊每歲農隙赴縣教閱一月，其差官置場，排備軍器，教閱法式番次，按賞費用，令樞密院、三省同立法。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that capital-district and three-circuit baojia from the first month of the coming year onward all cease mass drill, yet as before each year in the farming interval go to the county for one month's drill; as for dispatching officials, setting grounds, arranging weapons, drill methods and rotations, and review rewards and expenses, the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Three Departments were ordered jointly to legislate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered capital-district and three-circuit baojia to cease mass drill from the first month of the coming year, while retaining the old annual month of county drill in the farming interval; the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Three Departments were to legislate jointly on officials, grounds, weapons, drill methods, rotations, and rewards.

sentences.zh: 後六日，光再上奏，極其懇切，蔡確等執奏不行。

translations.literal: Six days later Guang memorialized again, most earnestly; Cai Que and others held to their memorial and it was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Six days later Guang memorialized again with utmost earnestness; Cai Que and others held to their position and the proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 詔保甲依樞密院已得指揮，保馬別議立法。

translations.literal: An edict ordered baojia to follow instructions already obtained from the Bureau of Military Affairs; protected horses were to be legislated separately.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered baojia to follow instructions already issued by the Bureau of Military Affairs; protected horses were to be legislated separately.

sentences.zh: 九月，監察御史王岩叟言：“保甲之害，三路之民如在湯火，未必皆法之弊，蓋由提舉一司上下官吏逼之使然。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Supervising Censor Wang Yansou said: "The harm of baojia—the people of the three circuits are as in boiling water and fire; it is not necessarily all a flaw in the law, but largely because the promotion office's officials high and low forced it to be so.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Supervising Censor Wang Yansou said: "The harm of baojia has left the people of the three circuits in boiling water and fire; this is not necessarily a flaw in the law itself, but largely because officials throughout the promotion office forced matters to that point.

sentences.zh: 而近日指揮雖令冬教，然尚存官司，則所以為保甲之害者，十分之六七猶在，陛下所不知也。

translations.literal: Yet though recent instructions ordered winter drill, if the official apparatus still remains, then six or seven tenths of what makes baojia harmful still remain—what Your Majesty does not know.
translations.idiomatic: Though recent instructions ordered winter drill only, as long as the official apparatus remains, six or seven tenths of the harm of baojia still remains—what Your Majesty does not know.

sentences.zh: 此皆奸邪遂非飾過，而巧辭強辨以欺惑聖聽，將至深之病略示更張，以應副陛下聖意而已，非至誠為國家去大害、復大利，以便百姓，為太平長久之計者也。

translations.literal: All this is wicked men persisting in error and glossing faults, using clever words and forceful argument to deceive the sage ear, taking a disease about to reach the depths and showing only slight reform to answer Your Majesty's sage intent—not sincerely removing great harm for the state and restoring great benefit to ease the common people, as a plan for long-lasting peace.
translations.idiomatic: All this is wicked men persisting in error and glossing over faults, using clever rhetoric to deceive the imperial ear—offering slight reforms to a disease already deep, merely to satisfy Your Majesty's intent, not sincerely removing great harm for the state and restoring great benefit to ease the people as a plan for lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 此忠義之良心所以猶抑，奸邪之素計所以尚存。

translations.literal: Hence the loyal conscience is still suppressed and the wicked's long-standing schemes still remain.
translations.idiomatic: Hence loyal conscience remains suppressed and the wicked's long-standing schemes still endure.

sentences.zh: 天下之識者，皆言陛下不絕害源，百姓無由樂生；

translations.literal: Knowledgeable men throughout the realm all say that if Your Majesty does not cut off the source of harm, the common people have no way to live in joy;
translations.idiomatic: Knowledgeable men throughout the realm say that unless Your Majesty cuts off the source of harm, the common people have no way to live in peace;

sentences.zh: 不屏群邪，太平終是難致。

translations.literal: if the host of wicked men is not removed, great peace will in the end be hard to attain.
translations.idiomatic: unless the host of wicked men is removed, great peace will in the end be hard to attain.

sentences.zh: 臣願陛下奮然獨斷，如聽政之初行數事，則天下之大體無虧，陛下高枕而臥矣。

translations.literal: Your servant wishes Your Majesty to rouse yourself to independent decision, as at the beginning of listening to government you carried out several measures—then the great body of the realm would suffer no loss and Your Majesty could rest with head on pillow.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant wishes Your Majesty to rouse yourself to decisive action, as at the beginning of your rule you carried out several reforms—then the great foundations of the realm would remain intact and Your Majesty could rest at ease.

sentences.zh: ”十月，詔提舉府界、三路保甲官並罷，令逐路提刑及府界提點司兼領所有保甲，止冬教三月。

translations.literal: " In the tenth month an edict abolished all officials promoting capital-district and three-circuit baojia, ordering circuit judicial intendants and the capital promotion office to take concurrent charge of all baojia, with winter drill only for three months.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth month an edict abolished all officials charged with promoting capital-district and three-circuit baojia, ordering circuit judicial intendants and the capital promotion office to take charge of all baojia, with winter drill limited to three months.

sentences.zh: 又詔逐縣監教官並罷，委令佐監教。

translations.literal: Another edict abolished drill supervisors in each county and entrusted magistrates and assistants to supervise drill.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict abolished county drill supervisors and entrusted magistrates and assistants with supervision.

sentences.zh: 十一月，岩叟言：

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Yansou said:
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Yansou said:

sentences.zh: 保甲行之累年，朝廷固已知人情之所共苦，而前日下詔蠲疾病，汰小弱，釋第五等之田不及二十畝者，省一月之六教而為三日之並教，甚大惠也。

translations.literal: Baojia having been in force for many years, the court already knew what the people's feelings commonly suffered; yet the recent edict exempted the ill, eliminated the small and weak, released fifth-rank households with less than twenty mu of fields, and reduced six drills in a month to three days of combined drill—a very great grace.
translations.idiomatic: Baojia had been in force for many years and the court already knew the people's common suffering; the recent edict exempted the ill, eliminated the small and weak, released fifth-rank households with less than twenty mu, and reduced six monthly drills to three combined days—a very great grace.

sentences.zh: 然其司尚存，其患終在。

translations.literal: Yet if its office still remains, its scourge remains in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as long as its office remains, the scourge remains.

sentences.zh: 今以臣之所見者為陛下言，不敢隱其實以欺朝廷，亦不敢飾其事以罔成法。

translations.literal: Now what your servant has seen I speak to Your Majesty; I dare not hide the truth to deceive the court, nor dare I adorn the matter to mislead established law.
translations.idiomatic: Now I report to Your Majesty what I have seen; I dare not hide the truth to deceive the court, nor adorn the facts to mislead established law.

sentences.zh: 夫朝廷知教民以為兵，而不知教之太苛而民不能堪；

translations.literal: The court knew to teach the people to be soldiers, but did not know that teaching was too harsh and the people could not bear it;
translations.idiomatic: The court knew to train the people as soldiers, but did not know the training was so harsh the people could not bear it;

sentences.zh: 知別為一司以總之，而不知擾之太煩而民以生怨。

translations.literal: it knew to set up a separate office to oversee all, but did not know that harassment was too troublesome and the people therefore bred resentment.
translations.idiomatic: it knew to set up a separate office to oversee all, but did not know the harassment was so excessive that the people bred resentment.

sentences.zh: 教之欲以為用也，而使之至於怨，則恐一日用之，有不能如吾意者，不可不思也。

translations.literal: Teaching was meant to make them useful, yet if they are driven to resentment, then I fear that when one day they are used they may not act as we wish—this cannot go unconsidered.
translations.idiomatic: Training was meant to make them useful, yet if they are driven to resentment, I fear that when they are finally called upon they may not perform as we wish—this cannot go unconsidered.

sentences.zh: 民之言曰，教法之難不足以為苦，而羈縻之虐有甚焉；

translations.literal: The people say: the hardship of drill methods is not enough to be suffering, yet the cruelty of restraint and tethering is worse;
translations.idiomatic: The people say: the hardship of drill methods is not the worst suffering—the cruelty of constant restraint is worse;

sentences.zh: 羈縻不足以為苦，而鞭笞之酷有甚焉；

translations.literal: restraint is not enough to be suffering, yet the severity of flogging is worse;
translations.idiomatic: restraint is not the worst—the severity of flogging is worse;

sentences.zh: 鞭笞不足以為苦，而誅求之無已有甚焉。

translations.literal: flogging is not enough to be suffering, yet endless exactions and demands are worse still.
translations.idiomatic: flogging is not the worst—endless exactions are worse still.

sentences.zh: 方耕方耘而罷，方幹方營而去，此羈縻之所以為苦也。

translations.literal: Just as they plow and weed they are stopped; just as they work and build they are made to leave—this is why restraint is suffering.
translations.idiomatic: They are pulled away just as they plow and weed, just as they work and build—this is why restraint is so bitter.

sentences.zh: 其教也，保長得笞之，保正又笞之，巡檢之指使與巡檢者又交撻之，提舉司之指使與提舉司之幹當公事者又互鞭之，提舉之官長又鞭之，一有逃避，縣令又鞭之。

translations.literal: In drill, bao heads may flog them, bao chiefs flog them again, patrol envoys and patrol inspectors flog them in turn, promotion-office envoys and clerks flog one another's men, promotion officials flog them, and at any evasion the magistrate flogs them too.
translations.idiomatic: In drill, bao heads flog them, bao chiefs flog them again, patrol envoys and inspectors take turns flogging them, promotion-office envoys and clerks flog them mutually, promotion officials flog them, and at the slightest evasion the magistrate flogs them too.

sentences.zh: 人無聊生，恨不得死，此鞭笞之所以為苦也。

translations.literal: Men have no leisure to live and wish they could die—this is why flogging is suffering.
translations.idiomatic: Men have no leisure to live and wish only for death—this is why flogging is so bitter.

sentences.zh: 創袍、市巾、買弓、絛箭、添弦、換包指、治鞍轡、蓋涼棚、畫象法、造隊牌、緝架、僦椅卓、圍典紙墨、看定人雇直、均菜緡、納秸粒之類，其名百出，不可勝數。

translations.literal: Making robes, buying headcloths, purchasing bows, binding arrows, adding strings, changing finger guards, repairing saddles and bridles, building shade shelters, painting formation diagrams, making unit placards, sewing frames, hiring tables and chairs, pooling for paper and ink, hiring referees, sharing vegetable money, submitting straw grain—the names come forth by the hundreds and cannot be counted.
translations.idiomatic: Robes to make, headcloths to buy, bows to purchase, arrows to bind, strings to add, finger guards to replace, saddles and bridles to repair, shade shelters to build, formation diagrams to paint, unit placards to make, frames to sew, tables and chairs to hire, paper and ink to pool, referees to pay, vegetable money to share, straw grain to submit—the levies come by the hundreds beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 故父老之諺曰：“兒曹空手，不可以入教場。

translations.literal: Hence the elders' proverb says: "Boys must not enter the drill ground empty-handed.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the elders' proverb: "Boys must not enter the drill ground empty-handed.

sentences.zh: ”非虛語也。

translations.literal: " This is no empty saying.
translations.idiomatic: " This is no empty saying.

sentences.zh: 都副兩保正、大小兩保長，平居於家，婚姻喪葬之問遺，秋成夏熟，絲麻穀麥之要求，遇於城市，飲食之責望。

translations.literal: The capital deputy, two bao chiefs, and great and small bao heads, in ordinary life at home—gifts for weddings and funerals, demands at autumn harvest and summer ripening for silk, hemp, grain, and wheat, and in the market town expectations for food and drink.
translations.idiomatic: The capital deputy, the two bao chiefs, and the great and small bao heads—at home they expect wedding and funeral gifts; at harvest they demand silk, hemp, grain, and wheat; in town they expect food and drink.

sentences.zh: 此迫於勢而不敢不致者也。

translations.literal: This is compelled by power and none dare fail to present.
translations.idiomatic: Men dare not fail to pay, compelled by their power.

sentences.zh: 一不如意，即以藝不如法為名，而捶辱之無所不至。

translations.literal: At the slightest displeasure they take skill not meeting the law as pretext and beat and humiliate without limit.
translations.idiomatic: At the slightest displeasure they claim one's skill fails the regulations and beat and humiliate without limit.

sentences.zh: 又所謂巡檢、指使者，多由此徒以出，貪而冒法，不顧後禍，有逾於保正、保長者，此誅求之所以為甚苦也。

translations.literal: Moreover the so-called patrol inspectors and envoys mostly issue from these ranks—greedy and lawless, heedless of later calamity, some exceeding bao chiefs and heads; this is why exactions are most bitter.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover patrol inspectors and envoys mostly rise from these ranks—greedy, lawless, heedless of consequences, some worse than bao chiefs and heads; this is why exactions are most bitter.

sentences.zh: 又有逐養子、出贅婿、再嫁其母、兄弟析居以求免者，有毒其目、斷其指、炙其肌膚以自殘廢而求免者，有盡室以逃而不歸者，有委老弱於家而保丁自逃者。

translations.literal: Some drive out adopted sons, send out sons-in-law, remarry mothers, or divide brothers' households to seek exemption; some poison their eyes, cut off fingers, or burn their flesh to maim themselves and seek exemption; some flee with whole families and do not return; some leave the old and weak at home while baoding flee themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Some drive out adopted sons, send out sons-in-law, remarry mothers, or split households to escape service; some poison their eyes, cut off fingers, or burn their flesh to maim themselves; some flee with entire families never to return; some abandon the old and weak at home while the baoding flee.

sentences.zh: 保丁者逃，則法當督其家出賞錢十千以募之。

translations.literal: When baoding flee, the law requires pressing their families to pay ten thousand in reward money to recruit replacements.
translations.idiomatic: When baoding flee, the law requires their families to pay ten thousand in reward money to recruit replacements.

sentences.zh: 使其家有所出，當未至於逃；

translations.literal: If their families could pay, they would not yet have fled;
translations.idiomatic: If their families could pay, they would not have fled;

sentences.zh: 至於逃，則其困窮可知，而督取十千，何可以得？

translations.literal: once they have fled, their destitution is knowable—yet to press for ten thousand, how can it be obtained?
translations.idiomatic: once they have fled, their destitution is plain—yet how can ten thousand be extracted?

sentences.zh: 故每縣常有數十百家老弱嗟谘於道路，哀訴於公庭。

translations.literal: Thus in each county scores or hundreds of old and weak families constantly lament on the roads and plead in anguish at the yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in each county scores or hundreds of old and weak families constantly lament on the roads and plead in anguish at the yamen.

sentences.zh: 如臣之愚，且知不忍，使陛下仁聖知之，當如何也？

translations.literal: As foolish as your servant is, I yet know pity—if Your Majesty's benevolent sagacity knew, what would it be like?
translations.idiomatic: As foolish as your servant is, I yet feel pity—if Your Majesty's benevolent sagacity knew, what would you feel?

sentences.zh: 又保丁之外，平民凡有一馬，皆令借供。

translations.literal: Moreover beyond baoding, any commoner who had one horse was ordered to lend it for supply.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, beyond the baoding, any commoner who owned a horse was ordered to lend it for drill.

sentences.zh: 逐場教騎，終日馳驟，往往饑羸以至於斃，誰復敢言？

translations.literal: At each session of mounted drill they galloped all day; often from hunger and emaciation they died—who dared speak?
translations.idiomatic: At each mounted drill they galloped all day; horses often died from hunger and exhaustion—who dared complain?

sentences.zh: 其或主家倘因他出，一誤借供，遂有追呼笞責之害。

translations.literal: If the owner happened to be away on other business and once mistakenly lent the horse, there followed summons and flogging.
translations.idiomatic: If the owner was away on business and the horse was lent once by mistake, there followed summons and flogging.

sentences.zh: 或因官逋督迫，不得已而易之，則有抑令還取之苦，故人人以有馬為禍。

translations.literal: Or because official arrears were pressed, they had no choice but to sell—then there was the hardship of being forced to buy back; thus everyone regarded having a horse as calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Or pressed by official arrears they had to sell—then were forced to buy back; thus everyone regarded owning a horse as a curse.

sentences.zh: 此皆提舉官吏倚法以生事，重為百姓之擾者也。

translations.literal: All this is promotion officials relying on the law to create affairs and heavily harassing the common people.
translations.idiomatic: All this is promotion officials using the law to create trouble and heavily harassing the people.

sentences.zh: 竊惟古者未嚐不教民以戰，而不聞其有此者，因人之情以為法也。

translations.literal: I reflect that antiquity never failed to teach the people war, yet one does not hear of such things—because they made law from human feeling.
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that antiquity always taught the people war, yet one never hears of such abuses—because they made law from human feeling.

sentences.zh: 夫緣情以推法，則愈久而愈行；

translations.literal: When law is extended from feeling, the longer it lasts the better it runs;
translations.idiomatic: When law grows from human feeling, the longer it lasts the better it works;

sentences.zh: 倚威以行令，則愈嚴而愈悖。

translations.literal: when orders are carried out relying on awe, the stricter they grow the more they rebel.
translations.idiomatic: when orders rely on coercion, the stricter they grow the more people rebel.

sentences.zh: 此自然之理也。

translations.literal: This is the natural principle.
translations.idiomatic: This is the natural order of things.

sentences.zh: 獸窮則搏，人窮則詐，自古及今，未有窮其下而能無危者也。

translations.literal: When beasts are cornered they fight; when men are cornered they scheme—from antiquity to today there has never been one who drove his subordinates to extremity yet remained without peril.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered beasts fight; cornered men scheme—from antiquity to today no ruler who drove his people to extremity escaped peril.

sentences.zh: 臣觀保甲一司，上下官吏，無豪發愛百姓意，故百姓視其官司不啻虎狼，積憤銜怨，人人所同。

translations.literal: Your servant observes that in the baojia office, high and low officials, not a hair's breadth of love for the common people—the people regard their yamen as no less than tigers and wolves; accumulated rage and lodged resentment are shared by all.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant observes that in the baojia office not an ounce of love for the people remains; the people regard its yamen as tigers and wolves—accumulated rage and lodged resentment are universal.

sentences.zh: 比者保丁執指使，逐巡檢，攻提舉司幹當官，大獄相繼，今猶未已。

translations.literal: Recently baoding seized envoys, drove off patrol inspectors, and attacked promotion-office clerks; major cases follow one another and have not ceased even now.
translations.idiomatic: Recently baoding have seized envoys, driven off patrol inspectors, and attacked promotion-office clerks; major cases follow one another without end.

sentences.zh: 雖民之愚，顧豈忘父母妻子之愛，而喜為犯上之惡以取禍哉？

translations.literal: Though the people are foolish, would they forget love of parents, wives, and children and delight in the evil of offending superiors to invite calamity?
translations.idiomatic: Though the people are simple, would they forget their parents, wives, and children and delight in rebellion to invite disaster?

sentences.zh: 蓋激之至於此極爾！

translations.literal: It is only that they were driven to this extreme!
translations.idiomatic: They were driven to this extreme—that is all!

sentences.zh: 激之至深，安知其發有不甚於此者？

translations.literal: Driven so deep, who knows whether the outbreak may not be worse than this?
translations.idiomatic: Driven so deep, who knows whether the outbreak may not prove worse?

sentences.zh: 情狀如此，不可不先事而慮，以保大體而圖安靜。

translations.literal: The situation being thus, one cannot fail to consider beforehand in order to preserve the great body and plan for tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: The situation being thus, one must plan ahead to preserve the foundations of the realm and secure tranquility.

sentences.zh: 夫三時務農，一時講武，先王之通製也。

translations.literal: Three seasons devoted to farming, one season to arms—this was the former kings' general system.
translations.idiomatic: Three seasons for farming, one for arms—this was the former kings' general system.

sentences.zh: 一月之間並教三日，不若一歲之中並教一月。

translations.literal: Three days of combined drill in a month is not as good as one month of combined drill in a year.
translations.idiomatic: Three combined drill days in a month are inferior to one combined drill month in a year.

sentences.zh: 農事既畢，無他用心，人自安於講武而無憾。

translations.literal: When farming is finished and there is no other occupation, men naturally rest content in practicing arms without resentment.
translations.idiomatic: When farming is finished and there is no other occupation, men will practice arms contentedly and without resentment.

sentences.zh: 遂可罷提舉司，廢巡教官，一以隸州縣，而俾逐路安撫司總之。

translations.literal: Then the promotion office may be abolished and touring drill officials discarded, all placed under prefectures and counties, while circuit pacification commissions oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: Then abolish the promotion office and touring drill officials, place all under prefectures and counties, and let circuit pacification commissions oversee them.

sentences.zh: 每俟冬教於城下，一邑分兩番，當一月。

translations.literal: Each winter wait for drill below the city wall; one district divides into two rotations, each serving one month.
translations.idiomatic: Each winter drill below the city wall; one district divides into two rotations of one month each.

sentences.zh: 起教則與正長論階級，罷教則與正長不相誰何。

translations.literal: When drill begins they discuss rank with chiefs and heads; when drill ends they have nothing to do with chiefs and heads.
translations.idiomatic: When drill begins they deal with chiefs and heads on rank; when drill ends chiefs and heads have no authority over them.

sentences.zh: 庶使百姓得以優遊治生，無終年遁逃之苦，無侵漁苛虐之患，無爭陵犯上之惡矣。

translations.literal: Thus the common people may leisurely manage their livelihoods, without the suffering of fleeing all year, without the scourge of encroachment and harsh abuse, without the evil of contending, bullying, and offending superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the people may live and work at ease, without year-long flight, without encroachment and harsh abuse, and without rebellion.

sentences.zh: 且武事不廢，威聲亦全，豈不易而有功哉？

translations.literal: Moreover military affairs would not be abandoned and martial prestige preserved—is this not easy yet effective?
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs would not be neglected and martial prestige would remain intact—is this not easy yet effective?

sentences.zh: 惟陛下深計遠慮，斷在必行，以省多事，以為生靈安樂之惠，以為國家安靜之福。

translations.literal: Only may Your Majesty plan deeply and see far, resolve to carry it out, to reduce many affairs, to grant the living people ease and joy, and to secure the state's tranquility and blessing.
translations.idiomatic: May Your Majesty plan deeply, resolve firmly to act, reduce bureaucratic burdens, grant the people ease and joy, and secure the state's peace.

sentences.zh: 又乞罷三路提舉保甲錢糧司及罷提舉教閱，及每歲分保甲為兩番，於十一、十二兩月上教，不必分作四番，且不必自京師遣官視教，止令安撫司差那使臣為便。

translations.literal: He also begged to abolish the three-circuit baojia funds-and-grain promotion office and promotion drill review, and each year to divide baojia into two rotations for drill in the eleventh and twelfth months, without dividing into four rotations, and without dispatching officials from the capital to observe drill—only letting pacification commissions assign envoys would suffice.
translations.idiomatic: He also begged to abolish the three-circuit baojia funds office and drill promotion, divide baojia into two annual rotations for drill in the eleventh and twelfth months rather than four, and assign observers from pacification commissions rather than the capital.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 紹聖二年七月，帝問義勇、保甲數，宰臣章惇曰：“義勇，自祖宗以來舊法。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Shaosheng the emperor asked the numbers of yiyong and baojia; Chief Councillor Zhang Dun said: "Yiyong have been the ancestral law since the founders.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Shaosheng the emperor asked the numbers of yiyong and baojia; Chief Councillor Zhang Dun said: "Yiyong have been ancestral law since the founders.

sentences.zh: 治平中，韓琦請遣使詣陝西再括丁數添刺。

translations.literal: In the Zhiping era Han Qi requested dispatching envoys to Shaanxi to recount ding and add conscription.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiping era Han Qi requested envoys to Shaanxi to recount adult males and add conscription.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，先帝始行保甲法，府界、三路得七十餘萬丁。

translations.literal: In the Xining era the late emperor first implemented baojia law; the capital district and three circuits obtained more than seven hundred thousand ding.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xining era the late emperor first implemented baojia; the capital district and three circuits registered more than seven hundred thousand ding.

sentences.zh: 設官教閱始於府界，眾議沸騰。

translations.literal: Establishing officials for drill began in the capital district; public debate seethed.
translations.idiomatic: Official drill began in the capital district amid seething public debate.

sentences.zh: 教藝既成，更勝正兵。

translations.literal: Once drill skill was achieved they surpassed regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: Once their skills were trained they surpassed regular troops.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，始遣使遍教三路。

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng era envoys were first sent to drill the three circuits everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng era envoys were first sent to drill all three circuits.

sentences.zh: 先帝留神按閱，藝精者厚賞，或擢以差使、軍將名目，而一時賞賚率取諸封樁或禁軍闕額，未嚐費戶部一錢。

translations.literal: The late emperor attentively reviewed them; the skilled received generous rewards, some promoted to envoy or army-officer titles, while rewards at the time mostly drew on sealed stores or vacant places in the palace army—not a single cash from the Revenue Board.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor personally reviewed them; the skilled received generous rewards and some were promoted to envoy or army-officer titles, while rewards drew on sealed stores or vacant palace-army slots—not a single cash from the Revenue Board.

sentences.zh: 元祐馳廢，深可惜也。

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou era it was hastily abandoned—a deep pity.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou era it was hastily abandoned—a deep pity.

sentences.zh: 元符二年九月，御史中丞安惇奏乞教習保甲月分，差官按試。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Yuanfu Censor-in-Chief An Dun memorialized begging the months for drilling baojia and dispatching officials to examine them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Yuanfu Censor-in-Chief An Dun memorialized for set months of baojia drill and dispatched examiners.

sentences.zh: 曾布言：“保甲固當教習，然陝西、河東連年進築城砦，調發未已，河北連年水災，流民未復，以此未可督責訓練。

translations.literal: Zeng Bu said: "Baojia should indeed be drilled, yet Shaanxi and Hedong for years have advanced building walled forts and mobilizations have not ceased; Hebei for years has suffered floods and displaced people have not returned—for this reason training cannot yet be pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bu said: "Baojia should indeed be drilled, yet Shaanxi and Hedong have spent years building frontier forts with mobilizations unceasing; Hebei has suffered repeated floods and displaced people have not returned—training cannot yet be pressed.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“府界豈不可先行？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Cannot the capital district go first?
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Cannot the capital district go first?

sentences.zh: ”布曰：“ 熙寧中教保甲，臣在司農。

translations.literal: " Bu said: "In the Xining era when baojia were drilled, your servant was in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: " Bu said: "In the Xining era when baojia were drilled, I served in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 是時諸縣引見保甲，事藝精熟。

translations.literal: At that time the counties presented baojia for audience; their skills were refined and adept.
translations.idiomatic: At that time counties presented baojia for audience; their skills were superb.

sentences.zh: ”章惇即曰：“多得班行。

translations.literal: " Zhang Dun immediately said: "Many obtained clerical ranks.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Dun immediately said: "Many obtained clerical ranks.

sentences.zh: ”布曰：“止是得殿侍、軍將，然俱更差充巡檢司指揮。

translations.literal: " Bu said: "They only obtained palace attendants and army-officer posts, yet all were further assigned as patrol-office envoys.
translations.idiomatic: " Bu said: "They only received palace-attendant and army-officer posts, yet all were further assigned as patrol-office envoys.

sentences.zh: 以此，仕宦及有力之家子弟，皆欣然趨赴。

translations.literal: Because of this, sons of official families and powerful households all gladly rushed to join.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this, sons of official and powerful families all gladly joined.

sentences.zh: 及引對，所乘皆良馬，鞍韉華楚，馬上事藝往往勝諸軍。

translations.literal: When presented for audience they all rode fine horses with splendid saddles and bridles; mounted skills often surpassed the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: At audience they rode fine horses with splendid tack; mounted skills often surpassed the regular armies.

sentences.zh: 知縣、巡檢又皆得轉官或減年。

translations.literal: Magistrates and patrol inspectors likewise all obtained rank promotion or reduction of years of service.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates and patrol inspectors likewise gained promotion or reduction of service years.

sentences.zh: 以此，上下皆踴躍自效。

translations.literal: Because of this, high and low all eagerly exerted themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this, all ranks eagerly exerted themselves.

sentences.zh: 然是時司農官親任其事，督責檢察極精密，縣令有抑令保甲置衣裝非理騷擾者，亦皆衝替，故人莫敢不奉法。

translations.literal: Yet at that time Ministry of Revenue officials personally undertook the matter; supervision and inspection were extremely meticulous—magistrates who forced baojia to buy clothing and gear with unreasonable harassment were all displaced, so none dared not obey the law.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Ministry of Revenue officials personally oversaw the work with meticulous inspection—magistrates who forced baojia to buy gear with unreasonable harassment were removed, so none dared disobey.

sentences.zh: 其後乃令上番。

translations.literal: Afterward they were ordered to take rotating duty.
translations.idiomatic: Only afterward were they ordered to take rotating duty.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“且與先是府界檢舉施行。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "For now implement it as first proposed in the capital district.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "For now implement it first in the capital district as proposed.

sentences.zh: ”蔡卞曰：“於先朝法中稍加裁損，無不可之理。

translations.literal: " Cai Bian said: "To trim slightly from the former-court law—there is no reason this cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: " Cai Bian said: "Slight trimming of the former-court law is entirely reasonable.

sentences.zh: ”布以為甚便，容檢尋文字進呈。

translations.literal: " Bu thought it very convenient and asked leave to search documents and present them.
translations.idiomatic: " Bu agreed it was convenient and asked leave to locate the documents and present them.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蔡卞勸上復行畿內保甲教閱法，帝屢以督曾布。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Cai Bian urged the throne to restore capital-district baojia drill law; the emperor repeatedly pressed Zeng Bu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Cai Bian urged restoring capital-district baojia drill; the emperor repeatedly pressed Zeng Bu.

sentences.zh: 是日，布進呈畿內保丁總二十六萬，熙寧中教事藝者凡七萬，因言：“此事固當講求，然廢罷已十五年，一旦復行，與事初無異，當以漸行，則人不至於驚擾。

translations.literal: That day Bu presented that capital-district baoding totaled two hundred sixty thousand; in Xining those drilled in skills were seventy thousand, and said: "This matter should indeed be pursued, yet it has been abolished fifteen years—to restore it at once is no different from the beginning; it should be done gradually so people are not alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: That day Bu reported capital-district baoding at two hundred sixty thousand, with seventy thousand trained in Xining, and said: "This should be pursued, but after fifteen years of abolition sudden restoration equals starting anew; proceed gradually so people are not alarmed.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“固當以漸行之。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "It should indeed be done gradually.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "It should indeed be done gradually.

sentences.zh: ”布曰：“聖諭如此，盡之矣。

translations.literal: " Bu said: "With the sage instruction thus, all is settled.
translations.idiomatic: " Bu said: "With Your Majesty's instruction thus, all is settled.

sentences.zh: 若便以元豐成法一切舉行，當時保丁存者無幾，以未教習之人，便令上番及集教，則人情洶洶，未易安也。

translations.literal: If the Yuanfeng completed law were implemented all at once, few of that time's baoding survive—to make untrained men immediately take rotation and mass drill would stir popular alarm and not be easy to settle.
translations.idiomatic: If the Yuanfeng regulations were implemented all at once, few of that era's baoding survive—forcing untrained men immediately into rotation and mass drill would stir alarm and unrest.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，施行亦有漸。

translations.literal: In the Xining era implementation also had gradations.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xining era implementation was also gradual.

sentences.zh: 容臣講求施行次第。

translations.literal: Allow your servant to work out the order of implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Allow me to work out the order of implementation.

sentences.zh: ”退以語卞，卞殊以為不快，乃云：“熙寧初，人未知保甲之法。

translations.literal: " On retiring he spoke to Bian; Bian was quite displeased and said: "At the beginning of Xining people did not yet know baojia law.
translations.idiomatic: " On retiring he spoke to Bian, who was quite displeased and said: "At the beginning of Xining people did not yet know baojia law.

sentences.zh: 今耳目已習熟，自不同矣。

translations.literal: Now eyes and ears are already accustomed—it is naturally different.
translations.idiomatic: Now people are already accustomed—it is naturally different.

sentences.zh: ”布不答。

translations.literal: " Bu did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: " Bu did not reply.

sentences.zh: 徽宗崇寧四年，樞密院言：“比者京畿保甲投八百七十一牒乞免教閱，又二百三十餘牒遮樞密張康國馬首訴焉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongning under Huizong the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "Recently capital-district baojia submitted eight hundred seventy-one petitions begging exemption from drill, and more than two hundred thirty petitions blocked Military Affairs Commissioner Zhang Kangguo's horse to plead.
translations.idiomatic: In Huizong's fourth year of Chongning the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Recently capital-district baojia submitted eight hundred seventy-one petitions for exemption from drill, and more than two hundred thirty blocked Military Affairs Commissioner Zhang Kangguo's horse to plead.

sentences.zh: ”是月，詔京畿、三路保甲並於農隙時教閱，其月教指揮勿行。

translations.literal: " That month an edict ordered capital-district and three-circuit baojia all to drill in the farming interval; the monthly-drill instructions were not to be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " That month an edict ordered capital-district and three-circuit baojia to drill only in the farming interval; monthly-drill instructions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔河北東西、河東、永興、秦鳳路各武臣一員充提舉保甲並兼提刑，其見專提舉保甲文臣並罷。

translations.literal: In the fifth year an edict ordered Hebei East and West, Hedong, Yongxing, and Qinfeng circuits each to appoint one military official as baojia promoter concurrently serving as judicial intendant; existing civil officials solely promoting baojia were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year an edict ordered Hebei East and West, Hedong, Yongxing, and Qinfeng each to appoint one military official as baojia promoter and judicial intendant; civil baojia promoters were abolished.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔京畿差武臣一員充提舉保甲兼提刑，仍差文臣提刑兼提舉保甲。

translations.literal: That month an edict ordered the capital district to assign one military official as baojia promoter concurrently judicial intendant, while still assigning a civil judicial intendant concurrently as baojia promoter.
translations.idiomatic: That month the capital district was to assign one military baojia promoter and judicial intendant, while a civil judicial intendant also served as baojia promoter.

sentences.zh: 政和三年四月，樞密院言：“神考製保甲之法，京畿、三路聚教，每番雖號五十日，其間有能勤習弓弩該賞者首先拍放。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhenghe the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "The Divine Examiner devised baojia law; the capital district and three circuits held mass drill—each rotation though called fifty days, among them those who diligently practiced bows and crossbows meriting reward were first released by clapper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhenghe the Bureau reported: "The Divine Examiner devised baojia law; the capital and three circuits held mass drill—each rotation though called fifty days, those who diligently practiced bows and crossbows and merited reward were released first.

sentences.zh: 一歲之中，在場閱教，遠者不過二十七日，近者止於十八日而已。

translations.literal: Within a year, present for review drill, the distant did not exceed twenty-seven days and the near only eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year those present for drill did not exceed twenty-seven days for the distant and eighteen for the near.

sentences.zh: 若秋稼災傷，則免當年聚教。

translations.literal: If autumn crops suffered disaster, mass drill for that year was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: If autumn crops suffered disaster, mass drill for that year was exempted.

sentences.zh: 如武藝稍能精熟，則有激賞之法。

translations.literal: If martial skill became somewhat refined, there were incentive-reward methods.
translations.idiomatic: If martial skill became somewhat refined, incentive rewards applied.

sentences.zh: 鬥力出等，則免戶下春夫、科配；

translations.literal: if competitive strength ranked above grade, spring corvée and assessed levies under the household were exempted;
translations.idiomatic: if competitive strength ranked above grade, spring corvée and household levies were exempted;

sentences.zh: 最高強者，則解發引見，試藝命官。

translations.literal: the strongest were forwarded for audience, tested in skill, and given office.
translations.idiomatic: the strongest were forwarded for audience, tested, and given office.

sentences.zh: 行之累年，人皆樂從。

translations.literal: Carried out for many years, all gladly followed.
translations.idiomatic: After many years all followed gladly.

sentences.zh: 惟京東、西雖有團成保甲之名，未嚐訓以武事，慮其間亦有人材甚眾，能習武藝，可以命官任使之人。

translations.literal: Only Jingdong and Jingxi, though having the name of mass-formed baojia, had not been trained in military affairs; it was feared that among them were also many talents who could learn martial skills and be appointed to office and service.
translations.idiomatic: Only Jingdong and Jingxi, though called mass-formed baojia, had not been trained in arms; it was feared many there could learn martial skills and merit appointment.

sentences.zh: 今欲依三路保甲編修點擇條約。

translations.literal: Now it is desired to follow the three-circuit baojia compiled selection regulations.
translations.idiomatic: It is now proposed to follow the three-circuit baojia selection regulations.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 八月，樞密院言：“諸路團成保甲者六十一萬餘人，悉皆樂從無擾。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "Mass-formed baojia in the various circuits number more than six hundred ten thousand; all gladly follow without disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Bureau reported: "Mass-formed baojia in the circuits number more than six hundred ten thousand; all follow gladly without disturbance.

sentences.zh: 其京東、西路提舉官任諒已轉一官，直秘閣。

translations.literal: The Jingdong and Jingxi promotion official Ren Liang had already been promoted one rank to Directly Attached to the Secret Archive.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdong and Jingxi promoter Ren Liang had been promoted one rank to Directly Attached to the Secret Archive.

sentences.zh: 其朝議大夫已上與轉行，武臣武功大夫特與轉遙郡刺史，餘官減磨勘年有差。

translations.literal: Court Discussion Grand Masters and above received transfer promotions; military officials of Martial Accomplishment Grand Master rank were specially promoted to distant-prefecture cishi; other offices received differing reductions in merit-review years.
translations.idiomatic: Court Discussion Grand Masters and above received promotions; Martial Accomplishment Grand Masters were specially promoted to distant-prefecture cishi; other ranks received differing reductions in merit-review years.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年，詔提舉保甲督察州縣都保不如令者，限一月改正，每歲以改正多寡為殿最。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuanhe an edict ordered baojia promoters to supervise prefectures and counties: where capital-du bao did not meet regulations, one month was allowed for correction, and each year the amount of correction determined ranking.
