translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanhe an edict ordered baojia promoters to supervise counties: where capital-du bao failed regulations, one month was allowed for correction, with annual rankings based on results.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔諸路保甲法並遵依元豐舊制，京東、京西路並罷。

translations.literal: In the second year an edict ordered baojia law in all circuits to follow the Yuanfeng old system; Jingdong and Jingxi circuits were both abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict ordered all circuits to follow Yuanfeng baojia regulations; Jingdong and Jingxi were abolished.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔：“先帝若稽成周製保伍之法，自五家相比，推而達之，二十五家為一大保，二百五十家為一都保。

translations.literal: In the third year an edict stated: "The late emperor examined the Zhou system of bao and wu: starting from five households mutually compared and extending upward, twenty-five households formed one great bao and two hundred fifty one capital-du bao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict stated: "The late emperor examined the Zhou bao-wu system: from five households grouped together, extending upward, twenty-five formed one great bao and two hundred fifty one capital-du bao.

sentences.zh: 保各有長，都各有正，正各有副，使之相保相愛，以察奸慝。

translations.literal: Each bao had its head, each du its chief, each chief his deputy, making them mutually guarantee and care for one another to detect treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Each bao had its head, each du its chief, each chief his deputy, binding them to mutual protection and surveillance against wrongdoing.

sentences.zh: 故有所行，諸自外來者，同保互告，使各相知；

translations.literal: thus for any movement, all coming from outside were mutually reported within the bao so each would know the other;
translations.idiomatic: thus any traveler from outside was reported within the bao so all would know one another;

sentences.zh: 行止不明者，聽送所屬。

translations.literal: those whose conduct was unclear were allowed to be sent to their jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: those of unclear conduct were sent to their proper jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 保內盜賊，畫時集捕，知而不糾，又論如律。

translations.literal: Bandits within a bao were to be gathered and captured on the spot; knowing yet not reporting was also punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits within a bao were to be captured immediately; failure to report was also punishable by law.

sentences.zh: 所以糾禁幾察，纖悉具備，奇邪寇盜，何所容跡？

translations.literal: Thus correction, prohibition, and minute inspection were all complete in detail—where could strange evil and banditry find footing?
translations.idiomatic: Thus surveillance and prohibition were complete in every detail—where could evildoers and bandits find footing?

sentences.zh: 訪聞法行既久，州縣玩習弛廢，保丁開收既不以實，保長役使又不以時。

translations.literal: It has been learned that the law having been in force long, prefectures and counties treat it lightly and let it lapse; registering and enrolling baoding is not truthful, and bao heads' corvée service is not timely.
translations.idiomatic: It has been learned that after long enforcement prefectures and counties have grown lax; baoding registration is false, and bao heads' corvée demands are untimely.

sentences.zh: 如修鼓鋪、飾粉壁、守敗船、治道路、給夫役、催稅賦之類，科率騷擾不一，遂使寇賊奇邪無復糾察，良法美意浸成虛文。

translations.literal: Such as repairing drum stations, decorating whitewashed walls, guarding wrecked boats, maintaining roads, supplying corvée labor, and pressing tax levies—assessments and harassment varied without end, so that bandits and evil were no longer investigated and the good law's fine intent gradually became empty form.
translations.idiomatic: Repairs to drum stations, whitewashed walls, wrecked boats, roads, corvée, and tax collection—endless levies and harassment—so bandits go unchecked and the good law has become empty form.

sentences.zh: 可令尚書省於諸路提點刑獄或提舉常平官內，每路選委一員，令專一督責逐縣令佐，將係籍人丁開收取實；

translations.literal: The Ministry of State Affairs may be ordered, from circuit judicial intendants or Ever-Normal granary promoters in the various circuits, to select and appoint one per circuit to supervise exclusively and press each county's magistrates and assistants to register enrolled ding truthfully;
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry may select one judicial intendant or Ever-Normal promoter per circuit to press each county's magistrates and assistants to register enrolled males truthfully;

sentences.zh: 選擇保正長，各更替如法，使鈐束保丁，遞相覺察，毋得舍亡賴作過等人，遇有盜賊，畫時追捕，若有過致藏匿者，許諸人告首，仍具條揭示。

translations.literal: select bao chiefs and heads, each rotated according to law, to restrain baoding and watch one another in turn, not harboring vagrants and wrongdoers; when bandits appear capture them on the spot; if anyone through fault conceals them, all may report and denounce, and regulations are to be posted in detail.
translations.idiomatic: select and rotate bao chiefs and heads by law to restrain baoding and watch one another, harbor no vagrants or wrongdoers, capture bandits on the spot, allow denunciation of concealers, and post the regulations in detail.

translations.idiomatic: Local militia after the Jianyan era

translations.idiomatic: Patrol Companies

translations.literal: (In the first year of Jianyan an edict ordered patrol companies in all circuit prefectures and armies to take the name Loyal-and-Righteous Patrol Companies, subordinate to pacification commissions, later recruiting village people for them.
translations.idiomatic: (In 1127 an edict renamed patrol companies in all circuits Loyal-and-Righteous Patrol Companies, subordinate to pacification commissions, later recruiting villagers.

translations.literal: Every ten men formed one jia, with a jia head and a squad leader;
translations.idiomatic: Every ten men formed one jia, with a jia head and squad leader;

translations.literal: four squads formed one section, with a section head;
translations.idiomatic: four squads formed one section with a section head;

sentences.zh: 五部為一社，有社長；

translations.literal: five sections formed one company, with a company head;
translations.idiomatic: five sections formed one company with a company head;

sentences.zh: 五社為一都，有都正。

translations.literal: Five companies formed one capital unit, with a capital chief.
translations.idiomatic: Five companies formed one capital unit with a capital chief.

sentences.zh: 於鄉井便處駐紮。

translations.literal: They were stationed at convenient places in the villages.
translations.idiomatic: They were stationed at convenient places in the villages.

translations.idiomatic: Spear-and-Staff Men

translations.idiomatic: (In 1128 Fujian was ordered to recruit five thousand men.)

translations.literal: Local Strongmen
translations.idiomatic: Local Strongmen

sentences.zh: （建炎四年，詔諸州守臣募土豪、民兵，聽州縣守令節製。

translations.literal: (In the fourth year of Jianyan an edict ordered prefectural defenders to recruit local strongmen and militia, subject to prefectural and county magistrates' control.
translations.idiomatic: (In 1130 an edict ordered prefectural defenders to recruit local strongmen and militia under magistrates' control.

sentences.zh: 後存留強壯，餘並放散。）〉

translations.literal: Righteous Troops
translations.idiomatic: Righteous Troops

sentences.zh: （紹興十年團集，諸州名數不等。

translations.literal: (In the tenth year of Shaoxing they were massed; numbers varied by prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: (In 1140 they were massed; numbers varied by prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後皆以縣令為軍正。）〉

translations.idiomatic: Later all took the county magistrate as army chief.)

translations.literal: Righteous Warriors
translations.idiomatic: Righteous Warriors

translations.literal: (In the first year of Shaoxing sons of good families in Xingyuan were registered: one from two ding, two from four ding; every twenty men formed one squad, called Righteous Warriors.)
translations.idiomatic: (In 1131 sons of good families in Xingyuan were registered: one from two males, two from four; every twenty formed a squad called Righteous Warriors.)

translations.idiomatic: Militia

translations.literal: (In the second year of Jianyan every fifty men formed one squad, with a chief and deputy.
translations.idiomatic: (In 1128 every fifty men formed one squad with chief and deputy.

translations.literal: One ding was taken from one household; two ding from five.
translations.idiomatic: One male per household; two from five males.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十四年，三丁取一，五丁取二，十丁取三。）〉

translations.literal: (In the fourteenth year of Chunxi: one from three ding, two from five, three from ten.)
translations.idiomatic: (In 1187: one from three males, two from five, three from ten.)

translations.literal: Archers
translations.idiomatic: Archers

sentences.zh: （建炎初，應諸路漢蕃弓箭手限百日自陳承襲，紹興間，以京城外閑地，依陝西沿邊例，招弓箭手蒔種。）〉

translations.literal: (Early in Jianyan Han and tribal archers in all circuits were given one hundred days to declare succession; in the Shaoxing era idle land outside the capital, following the Shaanxi frontier precedent, recruited archers to plant and settle.)
translations.idiomatic: (Early in Jianyan Han and tribal archers had one hundred days to claim succession; in the Shaoxing era idle land outside the capital recruited archers to farm, following the Shaanxi frontier model.)

sentences.zh: 土丁

translations.literal: Native Soldiers
translations.idiomatic: Native Soldiers

sentences.zh: （紹興中，詔依嘉祐措置，三時務農，一時講武，諸縣逐鄉置教場，自十一月起教，至次年正月罷教。）〉

translations.literal: (In the Shaoxing era an edict followed the Jiayou arrangements: three seasons for farming, one for arms; each county set drill grounds by township; drill began in the eleventh month and ended in the first month of the following year.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the Shaoxing era an edict followed Jiayou practice: three seasons farming, one for arms; counties set drill grounds by township from the eleventh month through the first month of the new year.)

translations.literal: Bajie generals
translations.idiomatic: Intercepting generals
